title: Charles VI to Count Leopold Viktorin Windischgrätz, Vienna, 3 February 1720 (DECODE R5019/R5020), Chancellery key R5017

steps.what: Fetched DECODE R5017-R5024 images and record pages; the letter records point to keys R5017 and R5018.
Mírka 2012 found: describes the private key and the Reichshofrat nomenclator, prints no decryption; web search found none.
Transcribed R5017 in full (syllabary 1-400, nomenclator 401-999; 41 low-confidence cells flagged).
No. 1 cipher numbers (26 passages) from the register copy, checked against the autograph (ct_1720-02-03.txt).
No. 1 decoded with R5017 via dec.py; key slips 31 = zu and 268 = ein found from sense; 446 and 638 stay uncertain.
All 35 passages read as German fitting the clear context and the 1720-22 diplomacy (Alberoni's fall, Beretti Landi marriage proposal).

Entry split under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): Nos. 2, 3, 6 in the private key R5018 moved to windischgraetz1720b with key5018.md and dec_R5018_letters.md; this entry keeps No. 1 in the Chancellery key R5017. Fraction recomputed on No. 1: 221/223.

outcome.method_basis: The DECODE letter records point to the Chancellery key R5017, which Mirka (2012) had described; the project transcribed it and applied it directly to No. 1, with two key slips corrected.
outcome.fraction_read_source: dec_R5017_letter.md: 223 cipher tokens of No. 1; the uncertain nomenclator values 446 and 638 counted unread (221/223).
outcome.notes: The key survives and was applied directly; no cryptanalysis. Split on 14 Oct 2026: the letters in the Emperor's private key R5018 (Nos. 2, 3, 6) are windischgraetz1720b.
